title: Act: Show execution action failures through actionError
summary: Add actionError state and pass it to ExecutionPanel.
description: Add actionError state to AdminApp, clear on start/success, set on non-401 failure with 'Request failed' fallback, route 401 to handleError, pass to ExecutionPanel.
acceptance_criteria: 401 failures invoke handleError and leave actionError empty
technical_constraints: No duplicate declarations of actionError or runExecutionAction

steps.lines: the function added by the handlers Act
steps.action: Edit the existing runExecutionAction (do not declare a second one): call setActionError(undefined) before the await and again after success; in catch, if err is an ApiError with status 401 call handleError(err), else setActionError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Request failed').
Add the prop actionError={actionError} to the existing ExecutionPanel element.
steps.expected: The message renders in ExecutionPanel's role=alert paragraph.
